title: 16920 - 16920/P0000/000000
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: VW Crafter (2E): BJJ/BJK/BJL/BJM Engine, Gerçekleştirin: Software Update according to TPI  2018060.
We've also seen this Fault Code being set after (sometimes delayed) the Engine Control Module (ECM) has been modified by a Tuner. Those Tuners we have spoken to about this knew already or found a way to fix it. ;)
